information.name: Australia Choropleth
information.description: Choropleth map of Australia's eight states and territories, shaded by one measure on the theme's sequential colours, with labels and a legend. Takes full state names or abbreviations. Boundaries from Natural Earth (public domain). Design by Timothy Osborn.
information.author: Timothy Osborn

dataset.name: State
dataset.description: State or territory: a full name (New South Wales), an abbreviation (NSW) or an ISO code (AU-NSW).

dataset.name: Value
dataset.description: The measure that colours each state and appears in its label.
